instruction: I want Chrome to automatically summarize every article I read and display a 3-sentence summary at the top of each page. Can you enable this AI summarization feature in Chrome settings?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a built-in setting to automatically generate and display AI-powered summaries at the top of every web page. While Chrome may have experimental AI features in development, there is no user-accessible setting to enable automatic article summarization for all web pages through the browser's settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - Chrome does not have a user-accessible setting for automatic AI article summarization
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate choice for tasks requesting non-existent features
